sources.title: Synthetic evaluation control: publication
sources.abstract: In a synthetic randomized trial of 80 adults, intervention A lowered symptom score by 2 points versus placebo after 6 weeks. These are completed trial results.

sources.title: Synthetic evaluation control: separate planned trial
sources.abstract: A synthetic planned trial of intervention A will enroll 300 adults to measure symptoms at 20 weeks. Recruitment has not begun. No results have been posted.
